facts.text: W Costa Navarino is the debut of the W Hotels brand in Greece.
facts.excerpt: W Costa Navarino marks the debut of the W Hotels brand in Greece.

facts.text: The hotel is set beachfront by the Ionian Sea in Navarino Bay.
facts.excerpt: Set beachfront by the Ionian Sea in Navarino Bay

facts.text: The hotel is for adults and young adults aged 12 and over.
facts.excerpt: this Escape for adults and young adults (12+)

facts.text: The sandy beach in front of the hotel stretches for 450 meters.
facts.excerpt: the Beach in front of W Costa Navarino stretches for 450 meters

facts.text: The WET Deck has an expansive infinity pool overlooking the sea.
facts.excerpt: The 450m-long sandy beach and WET Deck, with its expansive infinity pool overlooking the sea, create a high-energy atmosphere any time of the day.

facts.text: The one- and two-bedroom Escape Agora and W Suites have private pools steps from the beach or on a rooftop with views of Navarino Bay.
facts.excerpt: The expansive Escape Agora and W Suites, featuring 1 or 2 bedrooms, boast private pools located just steps away from the beach or on a rooftop with breathtaking views of Navarino Bay.

facts.text: The three-bedroom Oasis I and II Villas, in the gardens or on the beachfront, have private pools of up to 40 square meters.
facts.excerpt: the magnificent 3-bedroom Oasis I & II Villas, situated amidst lush gardens or beachfront, showcase private pools up to 40 sqm.

facts.text: The design is inspired by the region's architecture and natural materials like stone, wood and reed.
facts.excerpt: distinctive design inspired by the region’s architecture and natural materials like stone, wood, and reed

facts.text: Room choices include bay, marina and panorama view rooms and swim-up rooms in the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Choose from bay, marina, and panorama view rooms, swim-up rooms in the gardens

facts.text: AWAY Spa offers tailor-made treatments, mani-pedis, a sauna and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: Recharge with tailor-made treatments, mani-pedis, and time in the sauna and steam room.

facts.text: A 25-meter outdoor lap pool sits just outside the FIT gym.
facts.excerpt: Located just outside the FIT Gym, a 25m-long outdoor lap pool is available

facts.text: Costa Navarino has four signature golf courses.
facts.excerpt: In Costa Navarino you can also find 4 signature golf courses

facts.text: A watersports hub offers diving, windsurfing and kitesurfing for all levels.
facts.excerpt: A dedicated hub for diving, windsurfing, kitesurfing and a curated range of watersports experiences for all levels.

facts.text: Navarino Agora, with dining, shopping, open-air entertainment and events, is steps away.
facts.excerpt: Navarino Agora adds dining, shopping, open-air entertainment, and curated events just steps away

facts.text: Guests can learn traditional Messinian cooking from local women in a village home in Pylos.
facts.excerpt: Visit our picturesque village home in Pylos and discover traditional Messinian cooking with the help of local women

facts.text: One-day cruises with skippers and crew visit secluded beaches reached only by boat.
facts.excerpt: Join our experienced skippers and crew aboard for one-day cruises and discover the secrets of this crossroads of ancient civilizations and swim in crystal-clear waters at secluded beaches reached only by boat.

facts.text: Work from upcoming Greek artists hangs on the natural stone walls.
facts.excerpt: a gallery-like collection of work from upcoming Greek artists gracing the natural stone walls

facts.text: Parelia serves Messenian cuisine as sharing plates in a beachfront setting.
facts.excerpt: Parelia celebrates Messenian cuisine with simple, generous sharing plates shaped by the land and sea.

facts.text: The resort is 45 minutes from Kalamata and a 2.5-hour drive from Athens.
facts.excerpt: Located 45 minutes from Kalamata, it is also within easy reach of Athens—a 2.5-hour drive.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes there isn't much local nightlife for those seeking a party scene.
facts.excerpt: there isn’t much in the way of local nightlife for those seeking a party scene.

facts.text: Nearby Navarino Dunes has the first European Mouratoglou Tennis Center.
facts.excerpt: At the nearby Navarino Dunes, the first European location for a Mouratoglou Tennis Center
